verdict.rationale: mParticle's Data Privacy Controls document a consent state that covers GDPR consent and CCPA data-sale opt-out. They also document forwarding rules that block data from reaching downstream outputs when an opt-out is present, and a Consent Filters guide exists. The evidence shows enforcement through rules the user configures, though, not automatic propagation of every consent category to all destinations, and it does not detail how consent is captured. missing for 10: documented capture mechanism (SDK/API consent collection), evidence that GDPR purpose categories are filtered per destination automatically without per-connection rule setup, detail beyond the Consent Filters page title, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, user consent is captured and enforced across destinations — opt-outs and consent categories are honored downstream automatically

citations.quote: Consent state powers both GDPR consent and CCPA data sale opt-out
Applying a forwarding rule of: Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present.
